children.text:
A closed set of components, each with its behaviour built in: lists, tables, trees, charts, editors, inputs, tabs, buttons, dialogs, toasts, spinners.

Anything that only <i>arranges</> them is data, not code: a project component or a recipe.

<accent+b>Try</>
<d>›</> <b>tab</> to the tab bar, <b>←</>/<b>→</> to switch
<d>›</> in <b>Outline</>: type to filter, <b>space</> folds
<d>›</> in <b>Text</>: click a <b>[ ]</> box

<pos+b>◆ Quest done.</>
<b>n</> for the next chapter.

<warn+b>◇ Quest</>
In <b>Outline</>, tick <i>Write the post</> with <b>x</>.

# Home

A tiny notebook. Click a link to open it beside this one: [[Groceries]], [[Ideas]], [[Trip]].
Shift-click opens it here instead. Tags are links too: #fictty #demo

- Tab nests a line under the one above it
- Enter on a list item starts the next one
- [ ] Ctrl-T ticks a task, or makes a line one
